description: ROME Framework Hooks - Activity Log Memory Replacement
scope: Only 2 hooks for activity log reminders after task completion

tool-use.name: rome-artifact-creation-reminder
tool-use.description: Remind robot to update activity log after creating artifact

action.message:
📋 You created an artifact. Update activity log:
   mcp__activity-log__append({type: 'STORY', id: '<story-id>', attributes: {status: 'COMPLETED', artifact: '${file_path}'}})

tool-use.name: rome-todo-completion-reminder
tool-use.description: Remind to update activity log when TODO marked complete

action.message: ✅ TODO marked complete. Verify activity log reflects this completion.

deployment.notes: Same 2 hooks for all 9 robots. Bootstrap excluded (too short-lived).

development.description: All hooks active with verbose messages
